cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?

mechanism: A plays the unobtrusive host while using its control of the family welcome to extract a real apology from B without specifying the offense.
confusable: Not simply emotional pleading: A assigns the welcome tone and delays cordial performance until B says the needed sentence.
comparison: Tea waiting for real remorse versus parents arrival requiring a smile.
